narr: A trough of low pressure over the southern Appalachians combined with a southward moving backdoor cold front in Virginia for the development of scattered to numerous showers and storms over the northern Piedmont and Coastal Plain of central North Carolina in the evening hours. Trees were down due to strong storms in Nash and Halifax, as well as isolated flooding in Johnston County.
ev: High water was reported on business highway 70 in Smithfield, making the road impassable.
lsr: High water on business 70 in Smithfield under train tracks.
